scenarios.rationale: The presentation-only change does not intersect any frozen assumption or revalidation condition and does not alter T or P.
H1-RC1 explicitly requires revalidation when the information supplied for representing obstacle presence changes.
H1-RC2 explicitly covers changes to FR-7.2.2 and the object-category scheme.
H1-RC3 explicitly covers changes to the dangerous-zone definition and spatial-information basis.
The declared Phenomenon of Interest changes, invalidating the scope from which concern-relevant distinctions are derived.
The Evaluation Target itself changes, requiring the derivation to restart at RR1.
